- Total revenue reached £25,571.27 TW, up 56.2% WoW from £16,369.32 LW.

- CAMOFLAGE DESIGN TEDDY achieved the largest WoW increase at 6340.5%, growing from £12.60 LW to £811.50 TW.
- PINK HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUNTING experienced the largest WoW decrease at -61.5%, falling from £1,974.45 LW to £760.50 TW.
